images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: apartment hou

facade.notes: Lucas County Auditor block card (tax-assessment photo, parcel number in frame): a two-storey hip-roofed two-flat, one flat per floor, with a two-storey bay stacked over the porch roof; side door to the upper flat; shingle siding over the original wood; a hedge along the front; a garage visible behind

why.note: the Midwest two-flat: owner below, tenant above, on a single city lot
1940s-50s cement-asbestos shingle re-siding: the most common Great Lakes alteration before aluminium and vinyl
